changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.12.5 has been released! This hotfix IS required to continue to play online (when the servers come back)!

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️ 
```- Replaced offline mirror mode with 100cc.
- Reordered and changed the grand prix engine class selection menu.
- When making a new license, the default engine class selection for offline VS is now 150cc.
- Reordered some of the settings in the offline menus.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue where the award ceremony would occur on the last played track, sometimes causing a crash.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.```

You're welcome Patchzy.
Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip

(Note: Updating on the recomp might not be possible right now since it cant grab a specific file in the server, if this happens im sorry)
